methods.description: Read the complete Git tree without blob sizes, preserve existing sparse selection, and measure only selected blob OIDs with bounded no-lazy batch checks before storage admission. Actual local file-transport blobless promisor clones exercise absent excluded, selected and full-profile inputs, main refresh, no-fetch traces, object inventory preservation, exact repeated-blob byte accounting and submodule refusal. Existing allocator safety and worker identity tests remain required.

conclusions.text: Actual Apple Git allocation and desktop adoption are not established by the Linux fixtures; no geographic, production or deployment result is claimed.
